hud.ready: Evil Farm Owner is ready. Press {{key}} to view available workers.
hud.hotkey-conflict: Evil Farm Owner's H key conflicts with UI Info Suite 2. Set OpenMenuKey to K or use 'efo_roster'.
roster.title: Workers for Hire
roster.subtitle: Only currently hireable adult NPCs are shown. Select one to choose a farm-work contract.
roster.empty: No NPC is currently available for hire. Try again later.
roster.reason.available: Select to choose watering or harvesting, review wages, and confirm the named worker.
roster.reason.unsupported-character: This special character is not supported as a worker.
roster.reason.festival: A festival is active, so NPC schedules are protected.
roster.reason.event: An event or cutscene is active, so NPC schedules are protected.
roster.reason.missing-location: The NPC's current location cannot be confirmed safely.
roster.reason.island: The NPC is taking part in island or resort activity.
roster.reason.medical: The NPC is in a protected medical or bathhouse activity.
roster.reason.work: The NPC is at a protected workplace during work hours.
roster.reason.controlled: The NPC is walking a schedule or controlled by another activity.
roster.reason.movement: The NPC is already moving as part of another activity.
roster.reason.dialogue: The NPC is in a protected dialogue or route activity.
roster.reason.animation: The NPC is performing a protected scripted activity.
roster.reason.custom-npc: Custom NPC compatibility is unknown, so hiring is blocked.
roster.reason.evaluation-failed: Availability could not be evaluated safely, so hiring is blocked.
task-selection.title: Choose {{worker}}'s task
task-selection.subtitle: The worker is not hired yet. Choose a task to review its scope and today's itemized wage.
task-selection.watering.description: Prefer the right farm entrance, then use another safe boundary entrance if needed; water every reachable dry crop before 9 PM.
task-selection.harvesting.description: Harvest every reachable mature crop before 9 PM and visibly deliver every exact output.
contract.title: Watering Contract
contract.subtitle: Review today's rate, then confirm to dispatch this named NPC for one visible watering job.
contract.subtitle.watering: Review today's rate, then dispatch this named NPC to water all reachable dry crops.
contract.subtitle.harvesting: Review today's rate, then dispatch this named NPC to harvest and deliver all reachable mature crops.
contract.worker.preview-only: Named candidate · no hire has occurred
contract.worker.selected: Named worker · availability is checked again on confirmation
contract.limit.value.watering: All reachable dry crops before 9 PM
contract.limit.value.harvesting: All reachable mature crops before 9 PM
contract.notice.read-only: Preview only: there is no confirm button, reservation, charge, NPC control, or farm work.
contract.notice.confirm: The six-hour maximum is reserved. Settlement charges each started work hour (minimum one, maximum six) and refunds the rest after return.
contract.notice.rest-day: Rest-day authorization: every started work hour and the six-hour reservation use the shown triple rate.
contract.start.host-only: Only the host player can start an NPC work contract.
contract.start.already-active: A named NPC contract is already in progress.
contract.start.too-late: Watering contracts must start by 4:00 PM.
contract.start.must-be-on-farm: Stand on the main farm to watch the NPC perform this contract.
contract.start.worker-missing: The selected NPC could not be found safely. Reopen the roster.
contract.start.worker-unavailable: {{worker}} is no longer available. Reopen the roster to see the current reason.
contract.start.insufficient-funds: The contract needs {{gold}}g available for its maximum reservation.
contract.start.unsupported-map: This farm map is too large for the safe NPC pathfinder used by this contract.
contract.start.no-arrival: No genuine farm-boundary entrance has a safe arrival tile for the NPC.
contract.start.no-dry-crop: There are no dry planted crops on the main farm.
contract.start.no-reachable-crop: No dry crop has an object-safe walking path from and back to any farm-boundary entrance.
harvest.start.too-late: Harvest contracts must start by 4:00 PM.
harvest.start.no-mature-crop: There is no supported mature crop on the main farm.
harvest.start.no-reachable-crop: No mature crop has an object-safe walking path from and back to any farm-boundary entrance.
harvest.start.no-storage-chest: Place at least one ordinary player-owned chest on the main farm before starting a harvest contract.
harvest.start.quarantine-pending: A prior harvest still has quarantined cargo awaiting verified recovery. Open efo_quarantine before starting another harvest contract.
contract.start.lease-failed: The NPC could not be leased safely because their state changed. Reopen the roster.
contract.hud.dispatched: {{worker}} entered from the {{entrance}}. {{gold}}g is reserved until the contract settles.
contract.hud.entrance-fallback: {{worker}} could not leave the preferred entrance and switched to the {{entrance}}.
contract.hud.completed: {{worker}} returned: watered {{watered}}, skipped {{skipped}}, unreachable {{unreachable}}, time-deferred {{remaining}}. Paid {{paid}}g / {{hours}}h; refunded {{refunded}}g.
contract.hud.stopped: {{worker}} stopped: {{reason}} Watered {{watered}}, skipped {{skipped}}, unreachable {{unreachable}}, time-deferred {{remaining}}. Paid {{paid}}g / {{hours}}h; refunded {{refunded}}g.
contract.hud.restore-waiting: {{worker}} was taken over by another activity. The contract is waiting briefly for safe restoration.
contract.hud.restore-relinquished: {{worker}} remains controlled by another activity. This mod released its lease without overriding that controller.
contract.hud.restore-ownership-lost: {{worker}}'s lease ownership changed unexpectedly. This mod stopped without overriding the new owner.
contract.failure.dispatch: dispatch failed; the NPC was restored.
contract.failure.safety-stop: the world, time, or authority safety boundary changed.
contract.failure.travel-timeout: the trip to the crop timed out.
contract.failure.controller-conflict: another activity took control of the NPC.
contract.failure.restore-relinquished: another activity kept control of the NPC; this mod released its lease safely.
contract.failure.restore-ownership-lost: the NPC lease ownership changed unexpectedly.
contract.failure.path-interrupted: the path to the crop was interrupted.
contract.failure.entrance-stalled: the worker could not leave any safe farm-boundary entrance.
contract.failure.target-invalidated: the selected crop no longer needed watering.
contract.failure.return-path: a safe return path could not be started.
contract.failure.day-ending: the day ended before the contract completed.
contract.failure.unknown: an unknown safety check stopped the contract.
multiplayer.reject.schema: The host rejected an unsupported contract message schema.
multiplayer.reject.version: Every player must use the same Evil Farm Owner version.
multiplayer.reject.save: The request belongs to a different save.
multiplayer.reject.stale: The request belongs to an earlier in-game day.
multiplayer.reject.sender: The requesting farmer ID did not match the network sender.
multiplayer.reject.player: The requesting farmer is not connected to the host.
multiplayer.reject.worker: The requested worker ID was invalid.
multiplayer.reject.task: The requested task ID is not supported.
multiplayer.reject.funds: The requesting farmer no longer has enough money for the maximum wage reservation.
multiplayer.reject.worker-state: The selected NPC is no longer available on the host.
multiplayer.reject.recovery-state: The host disabled new contracts because its persisted replay ledger could not be validated.
multiplayer.hud.recovery-invalid: Safety error: the saved multiplayer replay ledger is invalid. New contracts are disabled to prevent duplicate charges or work.
multiplayer.hud.recovery-save-failed: Safety error: multiplayer recovery data could not be saved. New contracts are disabled until this is resolved.
multiplayer.hud.pending: Contract request sent to the host. Waiting for authoritative validation.
multiplayer.hud.pending-existing: A contract request is already waiting for the host.
multiplayer.hud.timeout: The host response timed out. State synchronization was requested; no local work was performed.
multiplayer.hud.accepted: The host accepted the contract and owns execution from this point.
multiplayer.hud.entrance-fallback: {{worker}} could not leave the preferred entrance; the host switched the contract to the {{entrance}}.
multiplayer.hud.result: {{worker}} finished {{task}}: work {{completed}}, requester inventory {{player}}, chest {{chest}}, overflow {{overflow}}, quarantine {{quarantine}}, dropped {{dropped}}. Paid {{paid}}g / {{hours}}h; refunded {{refunded}}g.
multiplayer.hud.result-stopped: {{worker}} stopped: {{reason}} Requester inventory {{player}}, chest {{chest}}, overflow {{overflow}}, quarantine {{quarantine}}, dropped {{dropped}}. Paid {{paid}}g; refunded {{refunded}}g.
harvest.hud.dispatched: {{worker}} entered from the {{entrance}} to harvest. {{gold}}g is reserved until the contract settles.
harvest.hud.completed: {{worker}} returned: harvested {{harvested}}, skipped {{skipped}}, unreachable {{unreachable}}, time-deferred {{remaining}}. Cargo: {{items}}. Requester inventory {{player}}, chests {{chest}}, overflow {{overflow}}, quarantine {{quarantine}}, dropped {{dropped}}. Paid {{paid}}g / {{hours}}h; refunded {{refunded}}g.

Requester inventory {{player}}, chests {{chest}}, overflow {{overflow}}, quarantine {{quarantine}}, dropped {{dropped}}. Paid {{paid}}g / {{hours}}h; refunded {{refunded}}g.
harvest.hud.emergency-drop: Warning: persistent harvest storage failed. Cargo was dropped visibly at {{location}} where possible; any failed drop is quarantined before finalization.
harvest.hud.quarantined: Safety warning: {{count}} harvest item(s) entered the persistent emergency quarantine. Retrieve them with efo_quarantine.
harvest.hud.quarantine-record: Critical storage warning: {{count}} harvest item(s) were preserved in a recovery record and will be restored into efo_quarantine before another harvest.
harvest.hud.quarantine-restored: Restored {{count}} harvest item(s) into the persistent emergency quarantine. Retrieve them with efo_quarantine.
harvest.hud.quarantine-pending: Harvest quarantine recovery remains fail-closed. The saved cargo record was retained; inspect the SMAPI log and do not remove this mod.
harvest.failure.target-invalidated: the selected crop was no longer mature at action time.
harvest.failure.storage-unavailable: no category-compatible chest could accept the complete harvest stack; the contract stopped.
harvest.failure.placement-audit: the harvested item placement audit did not balance; inspect the SMAPI log before saving.
harvest.failure.quarantine-pending: unresolved cargo is waiting for verified emergency quarantine storage.
overflow.busy: Wait for the active named contract to finish before opening harvest overflow.
overflow.locked: Harvest overflow is currently in use. Try again shortly.
quarantine.locked: Harvest emergency quarantine is currently in use. Try again shortly.
quarantine.host-only: Only the host can recover or open the emergency harvest quarantine.
gmcm.open-menu-key.name: Open roster key
gmcm.open-menu-key.tooltip: Key used to open the currently available named-worker roster.
gmcm.contract-settings.notice: Work scope, task rules, and wages are defined by each named NPC contract; there is no player-centered global scan setting.
report.none: No completed named contract report is available for this player.
report.destinations: Destinations: requester {{player}}, chest {{chest}}, overflow {{overflow}}, quarantine {{quarantine}}, dropped {{dropped}}.
cmd.roster: Open the named worker roster and choose a farm task.
cmd.overflow: Open the persistent harvest overflow inventory.
cmd.quarantine: Open the persistent emergency harvest quarantine.
cmd.report: Show the current player's most recent named contract report.
cmd.roster-world-not-ready: Load a save before opening the worker roster.
